# Anne Shirley & Rogerson

- [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md) — Mentor of — [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Sunday-school teacher · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) shows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) three plain new dresses she has made for her, disappointing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) who longs for fashionable puffed sleeves. The following day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends Sunday school alone in her plain clothes decorated with wild flowers and finds the experience dull, especially compared to the other girls in puffed sleeves. Upon returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) a candid report of the day's events and services.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school
